# Expansion Pack; Switch, update v786432 = 1.1.1, Japanese / English / Simplified and Traditional Chinese).
# Plays on a Xiaomi 2410DPN6CC (Android 16, Adreno 830): the logos, the title, the settings screen, a new game
# (faction select, the opening narration, the campaign map), the officer list and the city panel, at 30 fps as on
# the Switch, with sound and a working save.

# movies) + sdk. The frame rate, the audio renderer and the region layout below are the three things this game
# needed beyond the SDK's defaults; see the note.
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the
# base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column1: # the RomFS directory no other title has: 12 GB of 0001_SC / 0001_TC (message data), 0002 (the engine's .rdb
# archives) and 0004, plus the 49 add-on content volume under aoc/
# these extensions are stored uncompressed by nx_extract: the engine's archives are read by offset
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region, and the defaults hold. The game makes no nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion
# region in anything tested here: no "[mem] ... address regions live" line appears and the campaign runs the same at this 256 MB and at 4.375 GB.
# The SDK's node area is cut from 1 GB to 62 MB by dm/tools/sdk_patches.py for this sdk build (d9add76fc264), which is where that belongs
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain
# Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
